# Contributing Guidelines

## Private Repository Notice

This is a private repository. Only authorized team members may contribute.

## Getting Started

Before contributing, ensure you:

1. Have been granted appropriate access permissions
2. Understand and agree to maintain confidentiality
3. Have read the [Security Policy](SECURITY.md)

## Development Workflow

### Making Changes

1. Create a feature branch from `main`
2. Make your changes following project coding standards
3. Test your changes thoroughly
4. Submit a pull request for review

### Pull Request Process

1. Ensure your PR description clearly describes the changes
2. Link any related issues
3. Request review from appropriate team members
4. Address any feedback or requested changes
5. Ensure all checks pass before merging

## Code Review

All code changes must be reviewed by at least one other team member before merging.

## Questions?

If you have questions about contributing, please reach out to the project maintainers.
